review.trend-micro-vision-one.faq.q1: What makes Trend Micro Vision One different?
review.trend-micro-vision-one.faq.a1: The platform combines advanced AI/ML detection with comprehensive threat intelligence and proven enterprise capabilities. Its unique approach to threat prevention and response sets it apart in the market.
review.trend-micro-vision-one.faq.a2: Pricing is based on number of protected endpoints with tiered features. Contact sales for custom quotes based on your organization size and requirements.
review.trend-micro-vision-one.faq.q3: Is cloud or on-premise deployment available?
review.trend-micro-vision-one.faq.a3: Both deployment options are available. Cloud-native management is standard, with on-premise options for organizations with specific data residency requirements.
review.trend-micro-vision-one.faq.a4: Protection is available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile devices (iOS/Android), all managed from a single unified console.
review.trend-micro-vision-one.faq.q5: How effective is the ransomware protection?
review.trend-micro-vision-one.faq.a5: The solution uses behavioral detection and machine learning to identify ransomware encryption patterns, automatically isolating threats and providing rollback capabilities to recover encrypted files.
